**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Update the agent guide for Python 3.14**

When this line moves `.replit` to Python 3.14, the repository-wide guide still states that `.replit` declares Python 3.11. review_comments.author: Copilot
review_comments.body: PR description mentions "validating the repository-specific workflow input", but this change set only updates `.replit` and the technology inventory files; the audit workflow has no `workflow_dispatch` inputs to validate. Consider updating the PR description to match the actual changes, or add the missing workflow input validation if that was intended.
